content.stem: 以下哪些是与房地产公司相关的重大金融犯罪风险？(选择四项.)

options.A: 购买房产能够在一笔交易中实现大额资金的流动.
options.B: 犯罪网络可能会购置房产用作毒品储存、供应或种植、制造、分销非法毒品的场所.
options.C: 市场可能波动不定,买家可能无法获得丰厚的投资回报.
options.D: 实益所有权信息可能不透明,犯罪分子可能会滥用空壳公司和信托等安排.
options.E: 房地产交易通常涉及金融机构和其他专业把关人

content.stem_en: Which of the following are key financial crime risks associated with real estate companies? (Choose Four.)

options_en.A: Buying property allows for the movement of large amounts of funds in a single transaction.
options_en.B: Criminal networks could purchase real estate for use as supply houses or locations to grow, manufacture, or distribute illicit narcotics.
options_en.C: Markets can be volatile, and buyers may not achieve a strong return on their investment.
options_en.D: Beneficial ownership information might be opaque, and criminals may abuse arrangements like shell companies and trusts.
options_en.E: Real estate transactions often involve financial institutions and other professional gatekeepers.
